034/**
035 * Orchestrates multiple {@link AuthFilter} instances with first-success principal resolution, role aggregation, and
036 * all-failure aggregation semantics.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * Chain decision flow per request:
040 * <ol>
041 *    <li>Build the set of matching filters (those whose {@link UrlPathMatcher} pattern matches the request path, or
042 *       those registered without a pattern which always match).
043 *    <li>The request path is canonicalized first (path parameters stripped, empty and <js>"."</js> segments dropped,
044 *       <js>".."</js> segments resolved, each segment decoded once) so equivalent spellings of one path select the
045 *       same filters.  A path that cannot be canonicalized is refused.
046 *    <li>If no filters match the path, the request is refused with a {@code 401}, unless the chain was built with
047 *       {@link Builder#passThroughUnmatched()}, in which case it passes through unchanged.
048 *    <li>Iterate matching filters in declaration order, calling {@link AuthFilter#authenticate(HttpServletRequest)}:
049 *       <ul>
050 *          <li>{@link Optional#empty()} &mdash; filter doesn't apply this request; continue.
051 *          <li>{@link Optional#of(Object) Optional.of(AuthResult)} &mdash; success.  The first successful filter's
052 *             {@link Principal} wins for identity.  Subsequent successful filters contribute their roles to the
053 *             union only when they carry no principal of their own or the <b>same</b> principal (by
054 *             {@link Principal#getName()}); a filter that authenticates a <i>different</i> principal does not
055 *             contribute its roles, so a second identity cannot silently elevate the first.
056 *          <li>throw {@link AuthenticationException} &mdash; credentials present but invalid; record as a failure.
057 *       </ul>
058 *    <li>After iterating:
059 *       <ul>
060 *          <li>If at least one filter succeeded &mdash; wrap the request in {@link AuthenticatedRequestWrapper} with
061 *             the first-success principal and union role set; delegate to the next filter/servlet.
062 *          <li>If no filter succeeded but at least one threw &mdash; aggregate the {@code WWW-Authenticate}
063 *             challenges and send a {@code 401} response.
064 *          <li>If all matching filters returned empty (no credentials recognized) &mdash; pass through unchanged.
065 *       </ul>
066 * </ol>
067 *
068 * <p>
069 * {@code AuthFilterChain} itself implements {@link Filter} so it can be registered with a servlet container as a
070 * single filter at {@code "/*"} and delegate internally to its composed {@link AuthFilter} entries.
071 *
072 * <h2 class='topic'>Registration</h2>
073 *
074 * <p>
075 * The preferred registration path is via {@code @Bean}; {@code JettyServerComponent} auto-mounts an
076 * {@code AuthFilterChain} bean at {@code "/*"}:
077 *
078 * <p class='bjava'>
079 *    <ja>@Bean</ja>
080 *    <jk>public</jk> AuthFilterChain authFilters(BeanStore <jv>bs</jv>) {
081 *       <jk>return</jk> AuthFilterChain.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>bs</jv>)
082 *          .append(BearerTokenAuthFilter.<jsm>create</jsm>().pattern(<js>"/api/*"</js>).validator(<jv>jwtValidator</jv>).build())
083 *          .append(ApiKeyAuthFilter.<jsm>create</jsm>().pattern(<js>"/api/*"</js>).store(<jv>apiKeyStore</jv>).build())
084 *          .build();
085 *    }
086 * </p>
087 *
088 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
089 *    <li class='jc'>{@link AuthFilter}
090 *    <li class='jc'>{@link AuthResult}
091 *    <li class='jc'>{@link AuthenticatedRequestWrapper}
092 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/AuthFilterFramework">AuthN Filter Framework — Servlet-Layer Authentication</a>
093 * </ul>
094 *
095 * @since 10.0.0
096 */
097@SuppressWarnings({
098   "java:S1192" // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
099})
100public class AuthFilterChain implements Filter, Authenticator {
101
102   /**
103    * A single entry in the chain: an {@link AuthFilter} paired with an optional path pattern.
104    */
105   static class Entry {
106      final AuthFilter filter;
107      final UrlPathMatcher matcher;  // null = match all paths
108
109      Entry(AuthFilter filter, UrlPathMatcher matcher) {
110         this.filter = filter;
111         this.matcher = matcher;
112      }
113   }
114
115   /**
116    * Builder class.
117    */
118   public static class Builder {
119
120      private final BeanStore beanStore;
121      private final List<Entry> entries = list();
122      private boolean passThroughUnmatched;
123
124      /**
125       * Constructor.
126       *
127       * @param beanStore The bean store. May be <jk>null</jk>.
128       */
129      protected Builder(BeanStore beanStore) {
130         this.beanStore = beanStore;
131      }
132
133      /**
134       * Returns the bean store used by this builder.
135       *
136       * @return The bean store. May be <jk>null</jk>.
137       */
138      public BeanStore beanStore() {
139         return beanStore;
140      }
141
142      /**
143       * Appends a filter that applies to all request paths.
144       *
145       * @param value The filter to append. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
146       * @return This object.
147       */
148      public Builder append(AuthFilter value) {
149         reqnn("value", value);
150         entries.add(new Entry(value, null));
151         return this;
152      }
153
154      /**
155       * Appends a filter that applies only to requests matching the specified path pattern.
156       *
157       * <p>
158       * The pattern is parsed once at build time via {@link UrlPathMatcher#of(String)}.
159       * Supported forms: {@code /*}, {@code /api/*}, {@code /foo/{id}/*}, {@code *.ext}.
160       *
161       * @param value The filter to append. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
162       * @param pattern The path pattern. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
163       * @return This object.
164       */
165      public Builder append(AuthFilter value, String pattern) {
166         reqnn("value", value);
167         reqnb("pattern", pattern);
168         entries.add(new Entry(value, UrlPathMatcher.of(pattern)));
169         return this;
170      }
171
172      /**
173       * Lets requests whose path matches no entry pass through unauthenticated.
174       *
175       * <p>
176       * By default, a request whose path is matched by no entry is refused.  Use this when the chain protects only
177       * part of the URL space and the remainder is intentionally public.
178       *
179       * @return This object.
180       */
181      public Builder passThroughUnmatched() {
182         passThroughUnmatched = true;
183         return this;
184      }
185
186      /**
187       * Builds the chain.
188       *
189       * @return A new {@link AuthFilterChain}.
190       */
191      public AuthFilterChain build() {
192         return new AuthFilterChain(this);
193      }
194   }
195
196   /**
197    * Static creator.
198    *
199    * @param beanStore The bean store for future bean-store-aware features. May be <jk>null</jk>.
200    * @return A new builder.
201    */
202   public static Builder create(BeanStore beanStore) {
203      return new Builder(beanStore);
204   }
205
206   private final Entry[] entries;
207   private final boolean passThroughUnmatched;
208
209   /**
210    * Constructor.
211    *
212    * @param builder The builder containing the filter entries. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
213    */
214   protected AuthFilterChain(Builder builder) {
215      this.entries = builder.entries.toArray(new Entry[0]);
216      this.passThroughUnmatched = builder.passThroughUnmatched;
217   }
218
219   /**
220    * Orchestrates the composed {@link AuthFilter} entries for the incoming request.
221    *
222    * <p>
223    * See the class-level Javadoc for the full decision flow.
224    */
225   @Override /* Overridden from Filter */
226   public void doFilter(ServletRequest req, ServletResponse resp, FilterChain chain)
227         throws IOException, ServletException {
228      var hreq = (HttpServletRequest) req;
229      var hresp = (HttpServletResponse) resp;
230
231      try {
232         var result = authenticate(hreq);
233         if (result.isPresent())
234            chain.doFilter(new AuthenticatedRequestWrapper(hreq, result.get()), resp);
235         else
236            chain.doFilter(req, resp);
237      } catch (AuthenticationException e) {
238         AuthFilter.sendChallenge(hresp, e);
239      }
240   }
241
242   /**
243    * Runs the composed {@link AuthFilter} entries for the request and folds their results, without writing any
244    * response.
245    *
246    * <p>
247    * Selects the entries whose path pattern matches the request (or that have no pattern), runs each in declaration
248    * order folding results via an {@link AuthResultAccumulator} (first-success principal wins, roles union), and:
249    * <ul>
250    *    <li>returns the folded {@link AuthResult} if any entry succeeded;
251    *    <li>throws an aggregated {@link AuthenticationException} (combining all {@code WWW-Authenticate} challenges)
252    *       if no entry succeeded but at least one rejected the request;
253    *    <li>returns {@link Optional#empty()} if all matching entries returned empty;
254    *    <li>throws an {@link AuthenticationException} if no entry matches the path, unless the chain passes unmatched
255    *       paths through (see {@link Builder#passThroughUnmatched()}), in which case it returns {@link Optional#empty()}.
256    * </ul>
257    *
258    * @param hreq The incoming HTTP request. Never <jk>null</jk>.
259    * @return The folded authentication result, or {@link Optional#empty()}.
260    * @throws AuthenticationException If no entry succeeded but at least one rejected the request.
261    */
262   @Override /* Overridden from Authenticator */
263   public Optional<AuthResult> authenticate(HttpServletRequest hreq) throws AuthenticationException {
264      var urlPath = toUrlPath(hreq);
265      if (urlPath == null)
266         throw new AuthenticationException("Invalid request path.");
267
268      // Select matching entries.
269      var matchingEntries = Arrays.stream(entries)
270         .filter(e -> e.matcher == null || e.matcher.match(urlPath) != null)
271         .toList();
272
273      // No filters match this path.
274      if (matchingEntries.isEmpty()) {
275         if (passThroughUnmatched)
276            return oe();
277         throw new AuthenticationException("Authentication required.");
278      }
279
280      var acc = new AuthResultAccumulator();
281      List<AuthenticationException> failures = null;
282
283      for (var e : matchingEntries) {
284         try {
285            e.filter.authenticate(hreq).ifPresent(acc::add);
286         } catch (AuthenticationException ex) {
287            if (failures == null)
288               failures = new ArrayList<>();
289            failures.add(ex);
290         }
291      }
292
293      var folded = acc.result();
294      if (folded.isPresent())
295         return folded;
296      if (failures != null)
297         throw aggregate(failures);
298      return oe();
299   }
300
301   /**
302    * Builds the canonical request path relative to the context root, or <jk>null</jk> if the path is malformed.
303    */
304   private static UrlPath toUrlPath(HttpServletRequest hreq) {
305      var contextPath = hreq.getContextPath();
306      var uri = hreq.getRequestURI();
307      if (uri == null)
308         return UrlPath.of("/");
309      var path = (contextPath != null && !contextPath.isEmpty() && uri.startsWith(contextPath))
310         ? uri.substring(contextPath.length())
311         : uri;
312      var q = path.indexOf('?');
313      if (q >= 0)
314         path = path.substring(0, q);
315      var out = new ArrayList<String>();
316      for (var seg : path.split("/", -1)) {
317         var semi = seg.indexOf(';');
318         if (semi >= 0)
319            seg = seg.substring(0, semi);
320         if (seg.isEmpty())
321            continue;
322         var decoded = urlDecode(seg);
323         if (decoded.indexOf('/') >= 0 || decoded.indexOf('\\') >= 0 || decoded.indexOf(';') >= 0)
324            return null;
325         if (eq(".", decoded))
326            continue;
327         if (eq("..", decoded)) {
328            if (out.isEmpty())
329               return null;
330            out.remove(out.size() - 1);
331            continue;
332         }
333         out.add(seg);
334      }
335      return UrlPath.of("/" + String.join("/", out));
336   }
337
338   /**
339    * Aggregates multiple authentication failures into a single {@link AuthenticationException} carrying the
340    * combined {@code WWW-Authenticate} challenges and messages.
341    */
342   private static AuthenticationException aggregate(List<AuthenticationException> failures) {
343      var wwwAuth = failures.stream()
344         .flatMap(e -> e.getHeaders().stream())
345         .filter(h -> eqic(AuthFilter.WWW_AUTHENTICATE, h.getName()))
346         .map(h -> h.getValue())
347         .distinct()
348         .collect(Collectors.joining(", "));
349      var body = failures.stream()
350         .map(Throwable::getMessage)
351         .filter(m -> m != null)
352         .collect(Collectors.joining("; "));
353      var ex = new AuthenticationException(body.isEmpty() ? null : body);
354      if (!wwwAuth.isEmpty())
355         ex.wwwAuthenticate(wwwAuth);
356      return ex;
357   }
358

363   public void init(FilterConfig cfg) throws ServletException {
364      // No-op
365   }

370   @Override /* Overridden from Filter */
371   public void destroy() {
372      // No-op
373   }
